utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Pia. Let’s keep it simple: could you help sort the donations, and then we’ll load the boxes by 3 o’clock?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That works for me if we confirm the drop-off spot and what I should sort first. Can we pin down the tools and timing so I’m not guessing?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Yes — let’s use the shed by the driveway for the drop-off, and start with boxed items first. I’ll have the tools ready, and we can begin sorting right away so we’re set to load by 3.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good, Kira — I’ll keep an ear out while I’m out running errands.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Can you confirm you’ve got the extension cord and the toolbox covered?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Yep — I’ve got the extension cord and toolbox covered. I’ll let you know if I spot anything else we need.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — just send me the repair list when you get it, and I’ll take a quick look.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Will do — I’m still pulling the list together, and I’ll send it over as soon as I’ve confirmed everything.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Perfect — thanks, Cleo. Send it over when it’s ready, and I’ll jump in where I can.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Leo — I’ll share the repair drive list and timing shortly, and we can slot you into the task that fits best.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good — send the list when you’re ready, and I’ll take the first task that fits.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect — I’ll send it over shortly, and I appreciate you being ready to jump in.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I can sort the donations and be ready to load the boxes by 3 o’clock.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That’s great, Sam — thanks for jumping in. I’ll keep an eye out for the rest of the list and timing so we can line everything up.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good, Mara — just let me know if anything changes, and I’ll be ready.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely, Rey—I’ll send the repair drive details and start spreading the word around the neighborhood. We can get a few more hands on deck and fix up a lot together.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Quinn — send me the details and I’ll keep an eye out. Happy to help however I can.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great, Rey — I’ll send everything over and loop in a few more neighbors too. We’ll make this repair drive a good one.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I still don’t have the street name yet, but if you give me the nearest landmark, I can help pin down the repair drive fast.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’ve only heard bits so far, but I can pass along the nearest landmark as soon as I get it. That should help narrow down the repair drive quickly.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: That would help a lot—send me the landmark when you get it, and I’ll help narrow down the repair drive right away.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh—right, the repair drive! I’m a bit foggy on the details, but I’m happy to help however I can. Send me whatever you’ve got, and I’ll do my best to pitch in and tell a few neighbors too.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Thanks, Oren — I’ll send you the details, and if anything changes I’ll keep you posted.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Vik — I appreciate it. I’ll keep an eye out and do my best to help once you send the details.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Of course — send me the final time when you have it, and I’ll help get the word out and make sure it avoids pickup hours.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thank you, Faye. I’ll send the final time as soon as I have it, and I really appreciate you helping with the word and pickup hours.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Absolutely, Uli — just send it over when you have it, and I’ll spread the word and keep it clear of pickup hours.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That would be a huge help, Leo — could you start with the tools and then take a look at the loose fence panels?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yep — I’ve got the tools covered, and I’ll take a look at those loose fence panels too.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Noah — I really appreciate it. If you spot anything else while you’re there, just let me know and I’ll coordinate the next bit.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the repair drive is coming together nicely — folks are pitching in with tools and a few extra hands. If you want, I can keep an eye out for the latest details.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks, Tess — that’d help a lot. I’m still working to lock in the schedule, the tool list, and the drop-off spot so we’ve got the logistics clear before we spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Sure thing — I’ll listen for any word on the schedule, tools, and drop-off spot, and I’ll pass it along as soon as I hear it. Sounds like it’s shaping up well!

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Got it—send me the repair list and the date once you’ve confirmed them, and I’ll help sort it out.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Hana — I’ll send the repair list and date once I confirm them. If you have a street name or nearby landmark for the repair drive, that’d help me narrow it down fast.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Sure — I can send a nearby landmark if that helps. Which street names are you checking, and I’ll see what fits best?

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
